title: GE航空CEO：供应商交付改善，产量能否如期提升？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's head down to the Farnborough Air Show where Bloomberg's Guy Johnson is with the GE Aerospace Chairman and CEO Larry Kolkkaye.
segments.zh: 我们现在前往范堡罗航展，彭博社的盖伊·约翰逊将与GE航空航天董事长兼CEO拉里·库尔克会面。

segments.en: Hi, Sunny Am. Thank you very much indeed, Danny. Yes, welcome back to the Farnborough Air Show here in the UK. As you say, Larry Kolk is with me. Larry, great to see you. Thanks
segments.zh: 嗨，桑尼。非常感谢，丹尼。欢迎回到英国范堡罗航展。拉里·库尔克在我身边。拉里，很高兴见到你，感谢你抽出时间。

segments.en: for spending some time with us. Look, the first thing I've got to ask you is, why not are we sitting in front of a very big 747 with your name on it?
segments.zh: 首先想问，为什么我们没坐在一架印有你名字的大型747前？

segments.en: Well, it's the GE Aerospace name, Guy, good to be with you. This is our flying test bed. As you say, this is a 747-400. This is basically our airborne laboratory upon which we test all
segments.zh: 这是GE航空航天名字，盖伊，很高兴见到你。这是我们的飞行测试平台。如你所说，这是一架747-400，基本上是我们的空中实验室，用于测试所有发动机。

segments.en: of our engines. There's a lot of talk here at Farnborough as there often is at the air shows around the future of flight. We wanted to bring the flying test bed. You have to Farnborough
segments.zh: 范堡罗航展上有很多关于未来飞行的讨论。我们想带来飞行测试平台，让大家了解我们在机上所做的一切，以确保推出最安全可靠的发动机。

segments.en: just to reinforce and help people understand everything that we do on board and inside the plane to make sure that we're bringing forward the best possible engines from a safety and
segments.zh: 你们将用这个测试下一代窄体机发动机，比如737或A320的。范堡罗这里有个大辩论：下一代是开式转子还是传统涵道喷气发动机？

segments.en: reliability perspective. You're going to test the next generation of engines for narrow bodies at the 737 or the A320s on this because there's a big debate here at Farnborough about whether
segments.zh: 你们会用这架飞机来测试吗？正是。尽管它是宽体发动机，但我们可以测试几乎所有开发中的发动机。

segments.en: it's open rotor or the traditional kind of ducted jet engine for that next generation. Is this the aircraft you'd use to test that? Very much so. Even though it's a wide body engine,
segments.zh: 让我们谈谈航展和发生的事情。

segments.en: we can test virtually any engine that we might fly across our portfolio under development on the flying test bed. Cool. Let's talk a little bit about the show and what has happened
segments.zh: 我们可以在飞行试验台上测试几乎所有正在开发的发动机。
